name: Vrang's Game
summary: Vrang asks you to check his traps across a valley in the Barrens. The small game they catch will help him, while other wildlife can make the area dangerous.

sections.title: Vrang's Traps
sections.body: Vrang has traps scattered across the valley and asks you to bring back any small game they have caught. He warns that other wildlife can make the area dangerous if you lose focus.

faq.answer: Vrang asks you to check his traps and bring back the small game they have caught.
Vrang says his traps are scattered across the valley in the Barrens.

faq.q: What is dangerous around the traps?
faq.answer: Vrang warns that other wildlife in the area can be dangerous if you are not paying attention.
